projectDescription: A retro arcade-themed personal portfolio site built with React and React Router, featuring CRT overlay effects, neon pixel aesthetics, and gamified sections for showcasing skills, projects, writing, and case studies.
keyFeatures: Retro arcade 'Press Start' splash screen gate with fade-out transition
CRT monitor overlay with scanline and flicker effects
Keyboard-navigable arcade menu with arrow key support
Animated neon pixel color palette (green, magenta, cyan) on deep black background
High score table with animated counter roll-up on scroll entry
React Router SPA with static HTML pre-rendered pages for GitHub Pages deployment
Gamified case study page with scrolling 'boss HP' sidebar meter
Writing page with page-turn animation on article open
Contact form with coin-insert submission animation
publicApiSurface: CRTOverlay — fixed scanline and flicker overlay component
HighScoreTable — animated score counter with IntersectionObserver trigger
Tailwind arcade- color tokens: arcade-green, arcade-magenta, arcade-cyan, arcade-black, arcade-white, arcade-muted, arcade-yellow
